'''Davrin''' was a thin [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who owned the [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Corellian Thunder (freighter)|''Corellian Thunder'']]. He was paid to pick up the professional [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] [[Sienn Sconn]] from the [[Outland Region]] of [[Rydonni Prime]].<ref name="Easy" />
